details.reasoning: The agent implementation attempted size-limit enforcement but failed 16 tests. Critical missing behaviors include: should not retry request size error when retry(3) is configured; should not retry response size error when retry(3) is configured; should abort with ETOOLARGE when redirect response body exceeds maxResponseSize.

justification.issue_description: maxResponseSize enforcement was not applied to all incoming response payload paths: the Node implementation monitors only buffered responses, and the browser implementation does not enforce limits on download progress.
justification.evidence: The prompt states that an incoming response payload exceeding the configured threshold must return ETOOLARGE. In the agent patch, src/node/index.js:1183-1200 places response counting inside if (buffer), while src/node/index.js:1236-1246 completes unbuffered requests at headers. In src/client.js:800-811, the progress handler enforces only direction === 'upload'; download progress is attached at lines 825-828 but is not size-checked.
justification.verdict_reasoning: This is a missed explicit requirement rather than an undocumented test convention. The codebase visibly supports both buffered and unbuffered Node responses and has separate browser download progress handling, so a complete incoming-payload limit needs to cover those paths.

problem_assessment.notes: The task is challenging but solvable. Tests deterministically expose missing requirements.
